meta.description: A weekly-verified directory of MCP servers, agent skills and APIs for market data, trading, crypto, accounting and financial research — with pricing, free tiers and copy-paste install snippets for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini.

footer.disclaimer: Not investment advice. {site} is an information directory about software tools. Nothing on this site is investment, trading, tax or legal advice or a recommendation to buy or sell any security or asset, and we are not licensed investment advisers or portfolio managers. Trading involves risk of loss. Affiliate disclosure: some links (currently TradingView) are affiliate links. If you sign up through them we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. They are labelled, and they never affect listings, rankings or verification status.

common.affTitle: We may earn a commission if you subscribe. It doesn't affect rankings.

verified: Reachable, links alive, and (for repos) a commit in the last 180 days.
aging: Reachable, but no commits in 180–365 days.
stale: Reachable, but no commits in over a year. Test before relying on it.
archived: The repository is archived by its owner.
warning: A homepage, docs or endpoint link failed in the last check.
unreachable: The repository or homepage could not be reached.

about.title: About & how we verify
about.desc: How {site} lists and verifies finance and trading AI tools every week.
about.p1: {site} is an independent directory of AI tools for finance and trading: MCP servers, agent skills and data APIs. Most lists of AI tools are never re-checked. We re-check every listing automatically, every week, and show you the result.

about.c4: Links alive: homepage, docs and any hosted MCP endpoint respond.
about.c5: Pricing: copied from the vendor's own pricing page, with the URL and date. Unknown values are shown as “unknown” — we never guess.

disc.title: Disclaimer — not investment advice
disc.intro: {site} is a directory of software tools. All content is general information about software, its features and its published prices.
items: Affiliate disclosure. Some outbound links, currently to TradingView, are affiliate links marked "affiliate link" and tagged rel="sponsored". If you buy a subscription through them we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. Payment never affects which tools we list, how they rank, or their verification status, and a link is not an endorsement or a recommendation to trade.

No advice. Nothing on this site is investment advice, investment marketing, portfolio management, trading signals, or tax, accounting or legal advice, and nothing takes into account your personal circumstances. We are not licensed investment advisers, investment marketers or portfolio managers in any jurisdiction (including under Israel's Regulation of Investment Advice, Investment Marketing and Portfolio Management Law, 5755-1995).
No recommendation. Listing, ranking, a “Verified” badge or a sponsored placement is not a recommendation to use a tool, broker, exchange or asset.

Risk. Trading and investing — especially with automated or AI agents, leverage, options or crypto — can lose some or all of your money. Test any trading tool in paper mode first and never give an agent more permissions than you can afford to lose.

Third parties. Tools are built and run by third parties. We don't control them, their data, their security or their availability. Verification is automated and limited to the checks described on the About page.
Accuracy. Prices and features change. Always confirm on the vendor's site.
Affiliate & sponsored disclosure. Some links earn us a commission and some listings are paid placements. They are labelled.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft — to be reviewed before launch.
privacy.p1: {site} is a static website. We do not require accounts and do not set advertising cookies. Your language and theme choices are stored only in your browser (localStorage).
privacy.c1: Privacy-friendly, cookie-less aggregate analytics (page views, referrers, country).
privacy.c2: Information you send us when you submit a tool or buy a placement (name, email, tool details). Payments are processed by our merchant of record; we never see card numbers.
privacy.useP: To review submissions, deliver placements, and contact you about your listing. We don't sell personal data.
privacy.affP: When you click an affiliate link, the destination site may set its own cookies under its own policy.
privacy.rightsP: Ask us to access or delete your data at {email}.
privacy.c3: Newsletter: if you subscribe, we store your email address, language, signup time and a record that you consented, solely to send the newsletter. To limit abuse, each signup attempt also creates a temporary rate-limit key made from a one-way hash of your IP address (the IP itself is never stored); it is deleted automatically after 1 hour. Unsubscribe or request deletion of your data anytime by emailing {email}.

terms.title: Terms of use
items: The site is provided “as is” for information only. See the disclaimer — nothing here is investment advice.
Tool names and trademarks belong to their owners. Listings are factual descriptions; owners may request corrections or removal.
Sponsored placements buy visibility only, are labelled, may be declined or removed (pro-rata refund) and are billed by our merchant of record.
Submitters confirm they have the right to list the tool and that it makes no guaranteed-return claims.
Our liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the last 12 months.
If a translation differs from the English version, the English version applies.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: {site} is an independent directory of AI tools for finance and trading: MCP servers, agent skills and data APIs for market data, brokers, crypto, accounting and financial research. It lists {n} tools in {c} categories, with copy-paste install snippets for AI clients such as Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini.
faq.a2: Every listing is re-checked automatically every week: whether the repository is reachable or archived, the date of its latest commit, whether its npm or PyPI package exists and links back to the repository, and whether the homepage, docs and any hosted MCP endpoint respond. Pricing is copied from the vendor's own pricing page. Latest check: {date}.
faq.a3: Yes. Browsing the directory and listing a tool are both free. The site earns from clearly labelled sponsored placements and some affiliate links, and neither affects a tool's verification status. Each tool page shows that tool's own pricing and free tier.
faq.q4: How do I submit a tool?
